reference_user_text: Mo ní ọsàn mẹ́ta, mo sì ra méjì sí i. Ọsàn mélòó ni mo ní lápapọ̀? Dá mi lóhùn ní èdè Yorùbá nínú gbólóhùn kan.
expected_intent: The user has three oranges, buys two more, and asks how many oranges they now have. They request one sentence in Yoruba.
acceptance_criteria: State that the user now has five oranges; accept equivalent Yoruba phrasing and either a number word or digit.
Answer in one sentence without an unrelated explanation, question, or change of task.
review_note: Draft recording script. A fluent speaker must confirm wording and intended meaning before reference_reviewed is set true. This is one development interaction, not a benchmark.
